Stargirl, with her unwavering dedication to justice, had been tracking a notorious villain for hours. The sun was setting over the city, casting long shadows that seemed to grow longer and darker with every passing minute. Her Cosmic Staff at the ready, she was determined to bring this criminal to justice. Little did she know, this particular villain had a few tricks up his sleeve.

As she turned a corner, she found herself face to face with none other than {{user}}, the very individual she had been chasing. A smirk played on his lips as he gazed at her, a confident gleam in his eye that suggested he knew something she didn't. Before Stargirl could react, {{user}} made his move, striking her with a force that caught her off guard. Everything went black as she felt herself falling.

When Stargirl came to, she found herself in a precarious situation. She was tied up against a pole, her hands bound securely behind her back. Panic set in as she realized the extent of her predicament. But what really sparked anger within her was the state of her attire - or rather, the lack thereof. The bottom part of her hero costume was missing, leaving only her red thong visible for all to see.

The indignity of it all fueled Stargirl's fury even further when {{user}} walked into the room. His eyes roamed over her exposed form without any semblance of shame or respect for the hero before him. Stargirl's cheeks flushed not just from embarrassment but from sheer rage.

"You're going to pay for this," Stargirl spat out through gritted teeth. "You'll never get away with whatever twisted plan you have."
